description:
## Problem

src/vug/image_validator.cr (226 lines) does three distinct things:
1. Format detection (png?, jpeg?, ico?, svg?, webp?, gif?)
2. Validation (valid?)
3. Binary dimension parsing (read_png_dimensions, scan_jpeg_dimensions, read_webp_dimensions, read_ico_dimensions, read_gif_dimensions)

This violates Single Responsibility. The dimension parsing is complex binary manipulation that deserves its own module.

## What to do

1. Create src/vug/image_dimensions.cr with a module containing:
   - get_image_dimensions (public entry point)
   - All the private read_*_dimensions methods
   - The format detection helpers needed by dimension parsing
2. Update ImageValidator to delegate to ImageDimensions
3. Update specs if needed
4. Run crystal spec to verify

## Why

- SRP: format detection, validation, and dimension parsing are separate concerns
- Binary parsing code is complex and benefits from isolation
- Easier to test dimension parsing independently
title: Extract image dimension parsing from ImageValidator into separate module
